content: IndexedDB transactions are atomic per-transaction but provide NO cross-tab isolation: concurrent writes from multiple tabs can corrupt data and are never rolled back. Single-large-JSON-file storage works only with careful atomic write-temp-then-rename and a recovery/last-good copy; partial writes (tab close mid-write) corrupt the whole DB. Safari/iOS evicts IndexedDB after 7 days inactivity. Local-first downsides (per RxDB): cache/cloud divergence, eviction, multi-writer hazards. Mitigation: atomic writes, keep prior version, chunk the DB so one corrupt write doesn't lose everything.
